name: idea
description: Use when capturing ONE new idea the user voices and wants recorded — "save this idea", "I have an idea", "log this idea", "/idea", "idea: ...". Creates a provenance-tracked folder (one folder per idea) in your ideas repo, dedups against an index, optionally mirrors to a GitHub Project view filtered by label:idea. NOT for mining ideas out of transcripts/meetings (use a dedicated extraction skill) and NOT for dated work tasks (use an issue tracker / the manager skill). Triggers also in Russian: «запиши идею», «у меня идея», «зафиксируй идею».
